summary: Four mapped edges rejected before certification (maps explorations/god-names-fully-described.toml, revelation-possible.toml, god-founded-authority-truth.toml). STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE: the mapped extra premise 'full description entails reduced' is idle, since the reduced naming leaf alone entails the fuller one by antecedent strengthening; certified instead as a strength registration. STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-UNIQUE-MAXIME-ENS: the source edge from STMT-MAXIME-ENS-IS-WHAT-WE-CALL-GOD cannot be typed without editing that untyped existing statement; replaced by the typed operation-naming derivation. STMT-REVELATION-POSSIBLE-AND-RECOGNIZABLE: omnipotence, noncontradiction and exclusive signs cannot entail the primitive Signature field RevealsRecognizably without a bridge to it; the analysis bridge STMT-RECOGNIZABLE-REVELATION-ANALYSIS was added. STMT-DEFINITIVE-PROPOSAL-IS-GOD-CONFIRMED: a single founder-guarantee premise whose consequent is the conclusion would be a transcription; split through assistance.
